title: Adopt or retire five unlanded branches (Dot's discovery consumer and status record, Claude's corewave11/13/14)
goal: Decide on evidence, for each branch holding work that never reached origin/main, whether to adopt it (merge, keep authorship, verify against current main, land) or retire it with the precise reason. Branches are kept, never deleted.
limitations: No branch was deleted; all five remain at the heads listed.

The discovery consumer's line count against the ceiling was measured with the same rule as tests/lean_core_ceilings.rs (all .rs under src, top-level src/tests and src/mastery_tests excluded) by a shell count on the trial merge, not by running the ceiling test on that trial tree.

results.evidence: Net diff against its base 674dcc121 is one file, .agents/tasks/T-DOTSTATUS-1.json (status blocked). Schema-valid under tests/task_records.rs (id, title, accept.cmd cargo argv, created_by, created_unix). Its claims check out: candidate 3ded55ccf exists and xtask/src/bin/local-workflow.rs there is blob 348f430c90ffc68adb97b714444a0e6bbbbade6e as recorded; `git diff 674dcc121 cef0ed5b2 -- xtask/src/bin/local-workflow.rs` is empty, so the launcher was restored exactly to the claim base as recorded. Merged with --no-ff, keeping the four original commits (and so the candidate the record points at) in history. Its accept.cmd filter `status_paths` names tests that exist only in the parked candidate; on main it matches no test, which is consistent with a blocked record, not evidence of a pass.

Not present on main in any form (no discovery_plug module; the producer is commercial crates/susi-ecosystem-hub/src/model_discovery_plug.rs, topic ecosystem_hub.models.discovery.v1, published by susi-plug-host). The consumer is real and bounded: a trial merge on b3678bfd9 passed `cargo test --offline --locked -p susi-gemi-models --lib --test discovery_plug` (lib 254 passed, 0 failed, 2 ignored; discovery_plug 5 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored: the external-host conformance test that needs SUSI_DISCOVERY_HOST_BINARY). Retired because (1) susi-gemi-models measures exactly its line ceiling 15,950 on main and the merge measures 16,335 shipped src lines (+385), and the ceiling rule admits growth only from a crate leaving core, a plug port replacing a stub, or a security boundary; this is none of them; (2) nothing in core calls it: on the branch the only reference outside its own files is `pub mod discovery_plug;` in lib.rs, and its own doc says free discovery and bootstrap stay unchanged, so it would ship an unreached API in a pillar. Re-proposal path: wire a real opt-in caller and get a measured ceiling re-pin decision from the ceiling owner.

Two of five target modules are gone from core: crates/susi-gawd-swarm/src/wan_peers.rs (migrated to susi-fleet-command, acbed7f06) and crates/susi-gemi/src/model_preload.rs (removed, 8366e2ed6); `git merge-tree` reports modify/delete conflicts for both. The surviving three (susi-gemi operator_report.rs, susi-harness agents.rs and budget.rs) would only gain uncalled invariant verifiers: every new verify_* method is called from its own test module or from another new verifier, never from production code. Main removed exactly this class on purpose (refactor iterations 2-29, e.g. cdb14886e 'remove uncalled Wave 11 invariant verifiers in spend_tracker, capability_matrix, operator_report', 65917ba78 for harness provider_balance/mission_budget); on main only one verify_*_invariants definition remains (harness roi.rs verify_sova_invariants, called by susi-daemon crown.rs). susi-gemi has 16 lines of headroom (21,274 of 21,290) against +86 production lines in operator_report. The budget.rs insert also lands between BudgetGuard's doc comment and its struct, splitting that doc.

Two of five target modules are gone: crates/susi-gawd-agents/src/brain_ranking.rs (migrated to susi-frontier-lab, 6f99b3ee7) and cloud_explain.rs (pruned, e952d2a05); merge-tree reports modify/delete conflicts. The survivors (gawd-agents cloud_intent.rs, gmcp extensions.rs and tool_types.rs) would only gain uncalled invariant verifiers (callers only in test modules), the class main removed in iterations 2-29. susi-gmcp measures exactly its ceiling 25,900, so +170 lines would fail lean_core_ceilings. No GMCP file changes in this lane, so no GMCP evidence re-record is owed.

Two of three target modules are gone: crates/susi-config/src/env_profiles.rs (migrated to susi-fleet-command, ab27f6033) and offline_bundle.rs (migrated to susi-fleet-command, bf551b248); merge-tree reports modify/delete conflicts. The survivor, secret_ref.rs, would gain verify_ref_invariants, called only from its own test module: the uncalled-verifier class main removed in iterations 2-29.
